name: Haikoujou ni Mayoikonda Lolikko o Ninshin Suru made Okashite Mimashita
original_name: 廃工場に迷い込んだロリっ娘を妊娠するまで犯してみました
source:
Momo and Tsukushi, full of curiosity, go out on an adventure into an abandoned factory when they hear the rumor that ghosts may be haunting it.

At the same time, our hero, a part-time security officer, and his superior head out to the same factory to patrol it and keep an eye out for any illegal dumping of garbage.

The 2 girls and the lusty 2 men become trapped in a tight space in the factory, and the men violate them, and of course, cum inside them!

translation:
聽說一座廢棄工廠鬧鬼，好奇的小桃和筑紫決定進去探險。

同一時間，兼職當保全的主角也跟著上司來到工廠巡邏，檢視有沒有人非法傾倒垃圾。

兩個女孩和兩個心懷色慾的男人被困在廠內一個狹小空間裡。男人們強姦了她們，並在她們體內射精。
